block: SC-001 requires a claim visible on a second PHYSICAL host, which this lane cannot schedule.
background: FR-022 disqualifies a same-machine crossing, and I: is an SMB loopback of this host's own D:, so the obvious second endpoint is this host wearing another name.
The acceptance test now waits for the peer to ACK that it folded the claim; before that it timed a local append and a socket write, which is achievable with the peer switched off.
Measuring it needs one peer to bind UDP/47890 and publish node_id + spki, plus an elevated inbound firewall rule on this host that the session cannot self-elevate.
impact_if_unanswered: Era 102 cannot close, or closes with SC-001 falsely reported green.

options.label: Close with SC-001 named UNMEASURED
options.consequence: Era closes honestly; the criterion stays a named follow-up rather than a false green.

options.label: Elevate and measure this session
options.consequence: Needs the engineer's keyboard and a cooperating peer lane.

options.label: Block the era until SC-001 is green
options.consequence: Converts a named follow-up into an open-ended block on another host's availability.

recommendation.because: Ruling Q-GLPNETG28-02 already anticipated exactly this, and a named unmeasured criterion is honest where a green one would not be.

decision.rationale: Engineer ruled: close era 102 with SC-001 explicitly named UNMEASURED, carrying the exact step that would measure it.
